build.notes: Build from the exact pinned source commit with the exact pinned Go toolchain. Linux remains on the established generic build authority. Windows exact-head run 35556814556 proved the earlier pinned MinGW build byte-for-byte reproducible at SHA-256 72495e8300283ab5c8943827b1c6dd09c308dc11f0fc5c77074a99d0517fbff8 and validated the side-by-side runtime closure. On 2026-09-21 exact-head runner evidence showed the mingw64 repository had advanced GCC from 16.2.0-3 to 16.2.0-4 and split the former gcc-libs authority into cc-libs/libgcc/libstdc++; xz remained 5.8.4-1. The native lock now records that actually installed toolchain/runtime set. Exact-head A/B CI must re-prove byte-identical output, the reviewed executable digest and the clean-PATH runtime closure before this package can merge; the old digest is deliberately retained until that proof succeeds or a separately reviewed new digest is established. The Windows operator artifact recursively inspects PE imports, keeps Windows system imports external, copies every non-system MinGW dependency from the locked package set, hashes the copied closure, and requires a clean-PATH runtime smoke. This avoids pretending the executable is fully static while still delivering a self-contained operator directory with no manual DLL search.
